[https://mw.lojban.org/papri/jo'au Lojban Version]
== Introduction ==
[http://jbovlaste.lojban.org/dict/jo'au jo'au] is an experimental ''cmavo''. It was [https://groups.google.com/d/topic/lojban/QNNLNdgLB-c/discussion created] by [[la guskant]] and [[la ilmen]] with a goal of making known to a reader which version of Lojban they are reading.

Lojban has a number of different grammars or dialects.
